name: quality_gate
description: Run the `pmat quality-gate --checks all` suite (complexity, dead code, SATD, entropy, security, duplicates, coverage, documentation sections, provability) plus a TDG score against the given paths. Any check a path could not answer is named in `not_measured` and, with its reason, in `checks.not_run`.

strict.description: Fail on warnings as well as errors.
